title: PASSAGE accepted learner closure integration
purpose: Integrate the already accepted PASSAGE learner closure onto the current V6 product authority while leaving V6/factory authority unchanged. The recognized wave-a integration branch name is used only as CI transport routing; this work package is the semantic scope authority.
invariants: The 25 learner paths select the exact accepted e04 blob identities.
The work-package file is non-product scope metadata and is not part of learner closure equivalence.
No V6/factory authority path, workflow, contract, governor state, release or deployment path changes.
The branch label is transport routing only and does not confer PROG-WP-001 semantic authority.
GitHub main remains the sole executable product authority.
requiredEvidence: Fresh main equals exact base M before candidate creation and immediately before merge.
Candidate diff contains exactly 26 paths: the frozen 25 learner paths plus work-packages/PASSAGE-WP-001.json.
Every learner path blob equals the frozen accepted e04 blob identity.
PR scope resolves exactly PASSAGE-WP-001 and passes.
Learn-it Next CI reaches the recognized wave-a route and passes on the exact candidate head.
Any unrelated branch-gated workflow failure is classified non-material only when its sole failure is branch mismatch before product qualification.
Post-merge main readback equals the merge result and V6/factory authority files remain unchanged.
adversarialTests: Reject any learner blob not equal to the frozen e04 identity.
Reject any changed repository path outside the exact 26-path scope.
Reject any PR body naming zero or more than one work package.
Reject any material product or governnance CI failure.
Reject any main drift from exact M before merge.
Reject any change to V6/factory authority or release/deployment state.
nonGoals: Changing the V6 contract, factory, pointers or validators.
Reopening learner semantics already accepted at e04.
Changing PROGRAM_STATELOG or PASSAGE governor closeout.
independentReview: Verify exact 26-path diff and exact 25 learner blob map.
Verify PASSAGE-WP-001 is the only PR work-package token.
Verify the recognized wave-a route is used only as transport and no PROG-WP-001 authority is claimed.
Verify all material CI on the exact candidate head passes before merge.
Verify post-merge main and V6 non-mutation.
rollback: Revert the single PASSAGE integration merge. V6/factory authority and release/deployment state remain otherwise unchanged.
